revision_notes: Original score of 1 ('no requirements found') was uncited and is contradicted by evidence: cybersecurity decree-law n°17/2023 (11 Mar 2023) created an ANCS cloud-hosting certification scheme, and Circulaire n°16/2024 (22 Jul 2024) requires public bodies to host confidential/sensitive data with certified 'N-Cloud'/'G-Cloud' providers on Tunisian soil; enforcement is visible in Societe Tunisienne de Banque's 2025 tender explicitly requiring data 'localisation...sur le territoire Tunisien' via an ANCS-certified N-Cloud provider. This is a sectoral requirement (government/public-sector data, extending into public banking) rather than a comprehensive personal-data localisation law — a broader personal data protection bill (2025) that would extend obligations to foreign transfers of personal data more generally is still before parliament as of 2026 and not yet enacted. Revised code raised from 1 to 3 ('Sectoral requirements only').
